title: WarpToad executable development fixture
evidence_class: development artifact and behavior validation only

requirements: complete pinned checkout or archive identity
all five D1P-11 source hashes match
pinned lockfile and build scripts present
compiled circuit and ABI identity recorded
normal fork-free local consumer initialization available
setup_gate.failure_action: Stop before builds or proofs and report an exact blocker.
setup_gate.acir_reader_rule: Run the existing reader only against the pinned artifact. Report version/schema incompatibility; do not implement a new frontend in D1P-12.

artifact_chain: real proof and eleven public inputs

proof_generation.second_attempt_rule: Record a concrete, corrigible reason from attempt one before a second attempt; do not change the circuit, witness policy, proving mode, or parameters to seek success.
proof_generation.resource_stop: Stop on sustained unsafe memory pressure, disk exhaustion, runaway process trees, or inability to retain required evidence.

required_effect_checks: fee factor, priority fee, maximum fee, block base fee and computed relayer fee
same-proof repeated-nullifier rejection with revert evidence
restrictions: owned local execution and synthetic assets only
no D1 security or performance verdict
completion: One coherent accepted proof-to-mint chain with effects and replay rejection, or one exact reproducible blocker.
